products.name: Mono Solar Panel 450 W
products.description: A 450 W monocrystalline panel with an anodised aluminium frame. A good building block for rooftop systems on homes, shops and schools.

products.name: Mono Solar Panel 200 W
products.description: A 200 W monocrystalline panel for smaller homes and off-grid cabins. Pairs well with a 12 V battery and charge controller.

products.name: Portable Folding Panel 100 W
products.description: A 100 W folding panel with a carry handle and USB outputs. Charges power stations, phones and lanterns on the road or at camp.

products.name: Lithium Battery 2.4 kWh
products.description: A 24 V, 100 Ah lithium iron phosphate battery with a built-in management system and a charge gauge. Rated for thousands of cycles.

products.name: Gel Deep-Cycle Battery 12 V 200 Ah
products.description: A sealed, maintenance-free gel battery for solar storage. A dependable choice for lighting, TV and small appliances overnight.

products.name: Hybrid Inverter 5 kW
products.description: A 5 kW hybrid inverter with a built-in MPPT charge controller. Runs a whole home from solar, battery and grid, switching automatically.

products.name: Pure Sine Wave Inverter 1 kW
products.description: A 1 kW pure sine wave inverter that turns 12 V battery power into clean 240 V for TVs, laptops, fridges and routers.

products.name: All-in-One Solar Street Light 100 W
products.description: A street light with its own panel, battery and motion sensor. Lights compounds, driveways and paths from dusk to dawn with no wiring.

products.name: Solar Lantern with USB Charging
products.description: A bright, rechargeable lantern with three brightness levels and a USB port to charge a phone. Up to 30 hours on its lowest setting.

products.name: Home Solar Kit 300 W
products.description: Everything a small home needs to start on solar: a 300 W panel, a lithium power box, four LED bulbs and the cables to connect them.

products.name: Solar Water Pump 750 W
products.description: A 750 W surface pump driven straight from solar panels. Lifts water from shallow wells and tanks for irrigation and livestock.
